Lizelle Van Viegen Physiotherapist is a physiotherapy practice in Bothasig that treats patients using dry needling and physical therapy. These are the two services the practice lists for appointments, giving it a focused scope for musculoskeletal pain, restricted movement and related conditions that respond to manual, needle-based treatment.

Patients book sessions directly rather than walking in, and treatment runs Monday to Thursday from 9am to 6pm and Friday from 8:15am to 5:15pm, with the practice closed over weekends. Based on Vryburger Avenue in Bothasig, on Cape Town's northern side, it serves patients from Bothasig, Edgemead and the surrounding suburbs who need scheduled physiotherapy and dry needling care rather than a hospital-based service.

items.description:
OK MiniMark Brooklyn Junction is a convenience grocery store trading from the Brooklyn Junction retail centre on Koeberg Road. As part of the OK Foods group of independently run grocery stores, it stocks everyday food, drinks and household basics in a smaller-format setting than a full supermarket, aimed at quick, nearby shopping rather than a weekly big shop.

Local business directories list it under the grocery and convenience-store category for the Brooklyn area, reflecting its role as a walk-in stop for residents, commuters and shoppers passing along Koeberg Road. Based at 1 Koeberg Road in Brooklyn, it suits anyone in the surrounding Brooklyn and Milnerton-adjacent area who needs a fast, local option for topping up on groceries and household essentials between bigger shopping trips.

OK Minimark Eversdal is a neighbourhood convenience store on Sondal Road in Eversdal, stocked with everyday groceries and household basics. Customer reviews describe a small in-store bakery turning out fresh rolls and other baked goods daily, alongside the usual grocery lines, run by staff that regular shoppers describe as friendly and helpful.

Categorised online as a grocery store, greengrocer and supermarket in one, it gives Eversdal residents a nearby option for a quick top-up shop rather than a full weekly trip to a larger supermarket. Trading seven days a week from 6am to 9pm, and based in Eversdal, Cape Town, it suits local shoppers who want convenient hours and a personal, community feel over a big-box experience.

Panarottis Century City is a pizza and pasta restaurant trading from Canal Walk Shopping Centre in Century City. The branch's own listing confirms a Halaal designation, a liquor licence, and load-shedding-safe operation, so service continues through power cuts, alongside disabled-access facilities for customers who need them.

The restaurant also offers a children's play area, a designated smoking area and free WiFi, making it suited to families and shoppers settling in for a sit-down meal as well as diners wanting a quick bite between errands at Canal Walk. Serving families, shoppers and takeaway customers from its Shop 487 location in Century City, it combines an established pizza-and-pasta menu with the practical extras that make it workable for a longer visit.

PEP Brighton Square is a value retail store trading from the Brighton Square Shopping Centre on Ascot Street in Kraaifontein. Current store listings place it open from 9am to 5:30pm on weekdays, 9am to 2pm on Saturdays and 9am to 1pm on Sundays, giving shoppers a predictable window for a quick stop during the week or over a weekend errand run.

As part of the PEP chain, the Kraaifontein branch stocks affordable clothing, footwear and homeware alongside everyday technology and value-retail lines, covering men's, women's and children's ranges under one roof. It serves families and value-conscious shoppers across Kraaifontein and the surrounding area, with Brighton Square functioning as a convenient, single stop for budget-friendly basics rather than a specialist fashion destination.

PEP Erica Square sells affordable clothing for men, women and children, along with homeware, basic technology and other everyday value lines, from its branch inside Erica Square on Erica Drive in Belhar. The range is aimed at budget-conscious shopping rather than fashion-led retail, covering practical basics that a household needs regularly.

Store listings show the branch trading from around 9am to 6pm on weekdays and 9am to 2pm on Saturdays, closing at 1pm on Sundays, so shoppers have a consistent window for both a weekday stop and a weekend visit. Based in Belhar, the branch serves families and value-conscious shoppers across Belhar and the neighbouring suburbs, giving the area a nearby option for everyday clothing and household items without a trip into a larger mall.

As one of several PEP branches operating across Cape Town's southern suburbs, PEP Lansdowne Corner stocks the chain's usual range of affordable clothing, footwear, homeware and everyday technology, trading from Shop 9-11 inside Lansdowne Corner Shopping Centre.

Current listings for this branch show slightly longer trading hours than some other stores in the chain: open from 8:30am most weekdays, 9am on Wednesdays, with Saturday hours from 9am to 3pm and Sunday from 9am to 1pm. That slightly extended weekday and Saturday window gives shoppers more flexibility to fit a stop in around work or weekend errands. Trading from Lansdowne, the branch serves families and value-conscious shoppers across Lansdowne and the surrounding southern suburbs looking for budget clothing and household basics close to home.

PEP is one of the clothing and homeware retailers listed in the Capricorn Square shopping centre directory in Muizenberg, trading from a store alongside other fashion and grocery tenants in the centre. The directory places it among Capricorn Square's fashion-category shops rather than as a standalone store, reflecting its role as one of several value retailers inside the centre.

The branch carries PEP's standard range of affordable clothing, footwear and homeware for men, women and children, aimed at shoppers looking for everyday basics rather than fashion-led buys. Based inside Capricorn Square at the corner of Prince George Drive and Dury Road in Muizenberg, it serves families, children, adults and value-conscious shoppers from Muizenberg and the surrounding False Bay suburbs who combine a visit with other errands at the same centre.

Pick n Pay Lakeside is a supermarket trading from the Lakeside Centre on Main Road in Lakeside, stocking everyday groceries, fresh produce and household essentials. Customer feedback describes it as a smaller-format store, more of a convenience-sized Pick n Pay than a full hypermarket, with reviewers noting a recent in-store revamp and a decent fresh-produce section.

The store trades seven days a week from 8am to 8pm, giving Lakeside residents a long daily window for grocery shopping without a drive to a bigger centre. Reviewers also point to friendly, helpful staff as a feature of the shopping experience. Based in the Lakeside Centre, it serves households and local grocery shoppers across Lakeside and the surrounding southern-suburbs area who want a quick, dependable supermarket close to home.

items.description:
PnP Supermarket is the Pick n Pay-branded anchor store inside Eerste Rivier Shopping Centre, on the corner of Plein and Arlene Streets in Eerste River. The centre's own information describes the supermarket as its main grocery tenant, trading alongside a PnP Liquor store and a PnP Clothing store under the same roof, giving shoppers groceries, liquor and clothing in one stop.

Pick n Pay itself describes the format as a family-focused grocery business built on service and community, with the Eerste Rivier branch open daily from 8am to 8pm, including public holidays. Based in Eerste River, the supermarket serves households and families across Eerste River and the surrounding Cape Town suburbs who want a full grocery shop alongside the centre's other Pick n Pay-branded stores in a single visit.

PostNet Eerste River operates from Shop 118B inside Eerste River City Centre on Forest Drive, offering courier, printing and postal services to the surrounding community. As part of the PostNet network, the branch handles parcel collection and courier dispatch alongside everyday printing, copying and stationery needs for individuals, students and small businesses in the area.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturday from 9am to 1pm, closing on Sundays and public holidays, giving customers a clear weekday-and-Saturday-morning window to drop off parcels or printing jobs. Based in Eerste River, it gives households and local businesses a nearby alternative to travelling into central Cape Town for courier pickups, document printing or everyday postal and stationery needs.

PostNet Kenilworth is a printing, copying and courier shop in Kenilworth Centre on Doncaster Road. The branch lists A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards and photo printing on its store page.

The shop also offers name badges, rubber stamps, convenience stationery and packaging materials, along with courier services and Vox website services. The branch's store page also includes an online shop section for ordering products.

The branch is open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 17:00 on Saturdays and Sundays, and suits anyone in Kenilworth who needs printing, parcels or small business supplies close to home.

Rondebosch Medical Centre is a private hospital on Klipfontein Road in Rondebosch, managed by Africa Health Care, offering a 24-hour Accident and Emergency Unit alongside a full range of inpatient services. Facilities include operating theatres, dedicated surgical and medical units, intensive and high-care beds, and a paediatric ward for younger patients.

The hospital also runs maternity and labour services with a neonatal intensive care unit, together with cardiac services supported by a cardiac catheterisation laboratory, renal services, haematology and radiology departments. This combination allows the hospital to manage emergency, specialist, surgical and maternity cases under one roof rather than referring patients elsewhere for each service. Located opposite the Red Cross Children's Hospital in Rondebosch, it serves private healthcare patients across the southern suburbs who need emergency or specialist hospital care.

SA Power is an industrial automation business in Edgemead Business Park, Cape Town. It describes itself as a specialist in automating machinery and as the sole Lenze agent for Sub-Saharan Africa, providing complete system solutions for a wide range of applications.

The company supplies a curated range of automation products and designs and implements system solutions from the original concept. Its service side covers field service support, remote support and the repair of its products on installed systems, as well as machines imported with its products.

The business uses edge solutions to capture and visualise process data, and says it has delivered vision systems for manufacturers. The Edgemead unit suits factories and plant operators who need automation design, installation or ongoing support.

Shoprite LiquorShop Mandalay is a liquor retailer trading from Shop 11 in the Mandalay Shopping Centre on Swartklip Road, Khayelitsha. Liquor-licensing directory records list Shoprite Checkers (Pty) Ltd as the registered licence holder for the outlet, covering the sale of alcoholic beverages for consumption off the premises rather than an on-site bar or tavern.

As part of the wider Shoprite LiquorShop chain, the branch stocks beer, wine and spirits alongside the retailer's regular promotional specials, giving shoppers a dedicated liquor counter separate from the adjoining grocery store. Trading from Mandalay Shopping Centre, it serves adult customers across Mandalay, Lentegeur and the surrounding Mitchells Plain communities who want to combine a liquor purchase with their regular grocery shop at the same centre.

Simply Asia is a Thai and Asian restaurant trading from Alice Court on Main Road in Sea Point. Restaurant-directory listings describe its menu as strictly Halaal, built around Thai dishes and a broader range of Asian flavours, giving diners a Halaal-certified option within Cape Town's Thai and Asian dining scene.

The restaurant offers takeaway and delivery alongside sit-down dining, giving diners flexibility in how they order a meal. Based in Shop 8 and 9 of Alice Court on Main Road, it serves restaurant diners, takeaway customers and delivery customers across Sea Point and the surrounding Atlantic seaboard who are looking for Thai and Asian food with a Halaal menu.

Sneaker Factory trades from inside Golden Acre Shopping Centre on Adderley Street in Cape Town's CBD, where the centre's own store directory lists it among its fashion-category tenants. The store focuses on sneakers and casual footwear, giving shoppers in the CBD a dedicated stop for trainers rather than a general shoe department inside a bigger retailer.

Trading from a shopping centre that sits above the Cape Town railway station and bus terminals, the store is positioned for passing commuter and shopper foot traffic through one of the city centre's busiest retail buildings. It serves customers looking for casual and sport-styled footwear, sneakers and related accessories, making it a convenient option for anyone already moving through Golden Acre on their way to or from the station, rather than a destination shop on its own.

Stellenberg Pharmacy is a community pharmacy trading from the Stellenberg Centre on the corner of Reiger and Haarlem Road in Stellenberg, Bellville. Pharmacy-directory listings place it among the independent community pharmacies serving the northern Bellville suburbs, dispensing everyday medicines and pharmaceutical products rather than operating as part of a large retail pharmacy chain.

As a neighbourhood pharmacy, it gives residents a local option for prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines and general health products without needing to travel to a larger shopping centre pharmacy. Based in the Stellenberg Centre, it serves residents of Stellenberg and the surrounding Bellville suburbs who want a nearby, independent pharmacy for routine healthcare and medicine needs close to home.

items.description:
Sundoo is an Indian street food and tapas restaurant in Sea Point, drawing on South Indian and Kerala culinary traditions for its spicing and its small-plate, sharing-style approach to a meal. Rather than a conventional sit-down curry menu, the kitchen builds its dishes around snack-style street food and tapas portions meant for sampling and sharing across the table.

The restaurant was founded by a chef with roots in Kerala, India, a region known for its spices, and that influence runs through the menu's flavours. Sundoo now trades from three branches across Cape Town, with this one of three locations alongside Newlands and Woodstock.

The Sea Point branch trades from Shop 6, La Rhone, on Regent Road, open daily from 12:00 to 21:30, and suits diners after Indian street food, tapas-style sharing plates and South Indian flavours for lunch or dinner.

The Crazy Store in Meadowridge is a discount variety retailer stocking inexpensive household goods, novelty items and everyday products under one roof. The format is built around keeping prices low across a wide spread of categories, from kitchenware and storage to stationery, toys, decor, gifts and seasonal lines, making it a convenient stop for small, unplanned purchases rather than a single-category shop.

The branch trades from Shop 7-8 in Meadowridge Shopping Centre, on the corner of Firgrove Way and Howard Drive, serving shoppers in Meadowridge and the surrounding southern suburbs who want low-priced household and miscellaneous goods close to home.

Trading hours run Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 18:00, Saturday from 08:30 to 17:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 14:00, giving shoppers a wide window across the week to pop in for whatever the household needs.

Vida e Caffe Welgemoed is a branch of the South African coffee chain, serving espresso-based coffee and light cafe fare from inside Welgemoed Forum. Like other vida e caffe outlets, the branch follows the group's European-inspired espresso bar format, built around quick, well-made coffee and a short food menu rather than a full sit-down restaurant offering.

The chain describes its approach as bringing European espresso bar culture, with its own African flavour, to each of the locations it trades from, and this branch continues that same style for the Welgemoed community.

Trading from the corner of Jip de Jager Drive and Kommissaris Street in Welgemoed Forum, the branch serves local residents, commuters, shoppers and coffee drinkers passing through the centre, and suits anyone after a quick, quality coffee rather than a long meal.

Virgin Active at Table Bay Mall is a gym and health club on the West Coast of Cape Town, with a list of facilities that members can use. The club has a heated lap pool, a steam room, cardio and functional training areas, a Ride studio and a rowing area.

The club also offers Wattbikes, treatment rooms with health professionals, accessible changerooms, free WiFi and internet stations. Club-V provides an access-controlled space for children from six weeks to seven years while parents train.

Membership is offered in adult, youth and kids categories, with pricing that depends on age and the length of the contract. The club suits anyone in Bloubergstrand who wants a full gym and pool combined with child care and treatment in one place.

Vodacom's Cape Quarter store is a mobile telecommunications outlet offering cellular connectivity, mobile devices and related mobile services to customers in De Waterkant. As a store of one of South Africa's network operators, it forms part of the audio and electronics line-up of shops within the centre.

The store trades from Shop A08 & A09 inside Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village, a mixed retail and lifestyle precinct on Somerset Road that also houses other electronics, gifting and lifestyle tenants, placing it within easy reach of shoppers already visiting the centre.

It suits residents, workers and visitors in De Waterkant and the surrounding City Bowl who need a mobile phone, SIM card, device upgrade or network-related query handled without leaving the neighbourhood.

Woolworths (Rondebosch Village) is a Woolworths food and grocery store trading from Rondebosch Village on Klipfontein Road, stocking the retailer's usual range of groceries, fresh food and everyday household items. The store forms part of Rondebosch Village Shopping Centre, giving shoppers access to a wider mix of tenants on the same site.

The branch opens early and closes late, trading seven days a week from 07:30 to 20:00, which suits shoppers fitting a grocery run around work, school or weekend plans rather than only a fixed lunch-hour visit.

Trading from Shop 1, Rondebosch Village, 30 Klipfontein Road, the store serves local Rondebosch households and shoppers looking for a full Woolworths food offering close to home.

Zone Fitness at Cape Quarter is a gym offering both individual training and instructor-led group classes from inside the De Waterkant lifestyle centre. Members can use cardio equipment, weights and super-circuit equipment for independent workouts, alongside a timetable of group classes that includes boxing, yoga, Pilates, Zumba, step-and-tone and body conditioning.

The club is laid out as an open-plan studio, with separate male and female changing rooms, lockers, showers and toilets, fitting the brand's wider approach of practical, no-frills fitness spaces across its network of clubs.

Trading from The Square, corner of Somerset and Napier Street in Cape Quarter, the club is open Monday to Thursday from 06:00 to 21:00, Friday from 06:00 to 20:00 and weekends and public holidays from 07:00 to 15:00, suiting members who want cardio and strength training or a structured class close to home or work in De Waterkant.

items.description:
Ackermans is a South African value clothing retailer, with a branch trading inside Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek. The chain is built around affordable fashion for women, men, kids and babies, alongside cellular and tech deals, giving shoppers a mix of clothing and everyday essentials under one roof.

The Longbeach Mall branch brings that same value-focused range to the Noordhoek area, forming part of the mall's broader mix of fashion and family-focused retailers.

Trading from Shop G66, Longbeach Mall, on the corner of Buller Louw Boulevard and Sunnydale Road, the branch is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 08:30 to 17:00, suiting families and individuals in Noordhoek looking for value-priced clothing and homeware close to home.

Ackermans Westgate Mall is a branch of the South African value fashion retailer, trading inside Westgate Mall in Mitchells Plain. The store follows the chain's affordable-clothing model, built around fashion for women, men, children and babies together with cellular and tech deals, positioned as a lower-cost alternative to full-price fashion retailers.

Unlike some of its sister branches, this Westgate Mall store closes on Sundays, trading Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00, giving shoppers a clear weekday-and-Saturday window to plan around.

Situated on the corner of Vanguard Drive and Morgenster Road in Mitchells Plain, the branch serves families and individual shoppers across Westgate and the surrounding area who are looking for value-priced clothing, footwear and homeware without travelling into the Cape Town CBD.

Belle Ame Salon is a hair and nail salon in the Panorama Healthcare Centre, offering beauty treatments built around hair and nail care. The salon describes its approach as using hair products made with natural and rich ingredients, positioning its treatments as a gentler alternative to harsher chemical-heavy salon products.

Alongside hair services, the salon also offers nail care and broader beauty treatments, giving clients a single stop for both hair and nail appointments in one visit.

Trading from the corner of Hennie Winterbach Street and Rothschild Boulevard in Panorama, the salon is open Tuesday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 14:00, closed on Sundays, Mondays and public holidays, and suits women and men looking for hair and nail treatments in one appointment.

items.description:
Big Picture Company is a boutique film production company based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, servicing international commercials from around the globe. Rather than a marketing or advertising agency, the business operates as a production house, handling the filming and production side of commercial work for clients abroad.

The company was established in 2001 and has built decades of experience producing commercial content, bringing together production expertise with knowledge of shooting in and around Cape Town and South Africa more broadly.

Operating from corporate offices at The Old Biscuit Mill, 373-375 Albert Road in Woodstock, the business serves international commercial clients, advertising agencies and production partners who need a Cape Town-based crew and production team for their shoots.

Boston Coffee is a coffee roastery and café in Boston, Bellville, opened in 2014. The beans sold and served in the shop are roasted on site, and the business sells them whole or ground for French press, filter, espresso and other methods.

Beans come in 250g and 1kg packs, with a focus on the journey of coffee from farm to cup. A Nicaraguan Sergovia medium roast, for example, is described as balanced, with creamy cashew notes and fruity nuts.

The flagship café is on the corner of Cleveland Street and 12th Avenue in Boston, Cape Town. Customers can collect beans in store, ask for a courier to be arranged, or visit the café for a quick takeaway coffee.

Checkers at Okavango Crossing in Kraaifontein is a full-service supermarket that extends beyond standard grocery aisles, with its own in-store bakery, butchery, deli and coffee shop operating alongside the regular grocery sections. That mix lets shoppers pick up freshly baked bread, cut-to-order meat and prepared deli food in the same visit as a weekly grocery shop.

The branch trades from the corner of Langeberg Road and Okavango Road inside the Okavango Crossing shopping centre, forming part of the centre's retail offering for the surrounding Kraaifontein area.

Open daily from 08:00 to 20:00, the store serves households and families across Kraaifontein doing everyday grocery shopping, with the long trading window suiting shoppers fitting a grocery run around work, school or weekend plans.
